confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Vancouver prices, roughly CAD-converted and adjusted for mid-2026; they were not checked against live menus. Accommodation anchors are lower confidence because July is peak season and rates vary widely by neighbourhood. FX: the 0.6955 figure was not verified against the official RBA table. The rba.gov.au page was not opened or read; the value came from search-result summaries that attribute it to the RBA 4 pm rate for 2026-10-15. Those summaries also report 0.6947 for 2026-10-16 from a third-party site, which could not be confirmed as an RBA entry, so the server should verify the observation against the F11.1 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Seattle and Portland, Oregon, with a Canadian-dollar conversion adjustment. Vancouver's restaurant and hotel costs sit close to Seattle's, and its hostel and hotel tiers track the Pacific Northwest.
